goal: The users table stores first_name and last_name instead of full_name; done when reports/verify.md shows every row converted and the rollback was rehearsed

steps.title: Back up the users table
steps.proof: backups/users-before-0007.sql exists and its row count matches SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users

steps.title: Write the up migration that splits full_name
steps.proof: migrations/0007_split_name.up.sql runs on an empty test database with exit code 0

steps.title: Write the down migration that restores full_name
steps.proof: migrations/0007_split_name.down.sql runs after the up file on a test database with exit code 0

steps.title: Review the up and down migrations
steps.proof: Review report lists each issue with file and line, or says none found

steps.title: Rehearse up then down on a staging copy
steps.proof: reports/rehearsal.md shows the row count and a checksum of full_name are the same before up and after down

steps.title: Apply the up migration to production
steps.proof: reports/apply.md holds the migration tool output with exit code 0 and the run time

steps.title: Verify the converted rows
steps.proof: reports/verify.md shows SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE first_name IS NULL returns 0; if not, the down file is run and its output saved
